map.v_r = 30−20 = 10 m/s。即前者相对后者以 10 m/s 靠近/: v_r = 30−20 = 10 m/s. That is, the former approaches/recedes from the latter at 10 m/s.
map.前车 25 m/s，后车 32 m/s: Front car 25 m/s, rear car 32 m/s
map.v_rel=v₁−v₂=25−32=−7.000 m/s。若定义 v₁ 为前车，: v_rel=v₁−v₂=25−32=−7.000 m/s. If v₁ is defined as the front car, a negative value means the front car is approaching the rear car backward, i.e. the rear car is catching up.
map.取同向为正，反向则一正一负，v_r = v₁−v₂ 仍成立；结果为负表示反向远离: Take same direction as positive; opposite gives one positive one negative, v_r = v₁−v₂ still holds; a negative result means receding in opposite directions.
map.正负取决于你把谁当作参考物。工具按 v_rel=v₁−v₂ 计算：结果为正说明物: The sign depends on which object you take as reference. The tool computes v_rel=v₁−v₂: a positive result means object 1 recedes from object 2 along the positive direction. In practice, first set the positive direction, then substitute both velocities with their signs.
